steps.title: Ms. Okoro: community energy questions · part 1
steps.detail: Ms. Okoro asks for a community energy questions. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Ms. Okoro: community energy questions · part 2
steps.detail: The community energy questions now has conflicting notes. Ms. Okoro wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Ms. Okoro: community energy questions · part 3
steps.detail: Ms. Okoro is ready to introduce a paying client for the community energy questions. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented community energy questions. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Ms. Okoro.
